Deathcap multiplies AP; Void Staff and Shadowflame reduce effective MR on magic packets, with Shadowflame low-health amplification tested. Zhonya/Banshee are high AP stat slots; Riftmaker is fully ramped before scoring. Mana variants use earned Seraph for mana-derived AP, read live; burn variants use Liandry ramp and Blackfire one-target AP buff, with proc damage separate. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers.

builds.name: Deadly Venom: six-stack true-damage window
builds.summary: Investigate high six seconds of six-stack Deadly Venom output with a finite, reproducible setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high six seconds of six-stack Deadly Venom output with a finite, reproducible setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Each Venom stack deals a level-breakpoint base + 0.03 AP true damage per second for six seconds, up to six stacks. At level 18 the base is 5 per stack, so a nominal six-second, six-stack window is 180 + 1.08 AP before actual tick timing and expiry. Magic penetration does not increase this true packet.
